name: Quick Orders | Easy Product & Order System Management for F-Commerce
author: Md Abul Bashar

sections.description:
Quick Orders is a powerful WordPress plugin designed specifically for F-Commerce and social media-based businesses. It provides a streamlined solution for product management and order processing without the complexity of WooCommerce. With built-in Elementor widgets and a focus on simplicity, Quick Orders helps you manage your online business efficiently.

Why Choose Quick Orders?
– Perfect for Facebook/Social Media Commerce
– No WooCommerce Required
– Lightweight and Fast Performance
– Built-in Elementor Integration
– Designed for Bangladesh Market

Features Available Now:
– Customer Parcel History: Track parcel history for Bangladeshi customers.
– Seamless Elementor Integration: Design and customize order forms directly within Elementor.
– Easy Product Management: Effortlessly manage products without using WooCommerce.
– Fast Order Processing: Provides a simplified ordering process for a better user experience.
– Lightweight Setup: Works independently of WooCommerce, ensuring a fast and smooth setup.
– Customizable Layouts: Personalize your order interface to align with your branding.
– User-Friendly Dashboard: Intuitive admin panel for managing products.
– Responsive Design: Optimized for use across desktops, tablets, and mobile devices.
– Secure Transactions: Built with security best practices for safe handling of orders.
– Multi-language Support: Ready for localization
– Performance Optimized: Fast loading and efficient operation

Upcoming Features:
– Exciting new tools and enhancements for better functionality.
– Improved security measures and advanced controls.
– User experience refinements for smoother operation.
– Additional customization and performance improvements.
– Optimizations to support faster and more efficient workflows.
– Order Status Checker (Customers can check their Order Status)
– bKash Payment Gateways (Personal QR Code Not Automation)
– Product Grids Layout Widget for Elementor

Usage

After activating the plugin, manage your products from the admin dashboard and use Elementor widgets to display order forms on the public-facing site.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
Plugin Installation Method:

  1. Go to the WordPress dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Type “Quick Orders” in the search box.
  4. Click on the Install button.
  5. After installation, activate the plugin.

Installation via Zip File:

  1. Download the Quick Orders plugin zip file from WordPress.
  2. Go to your site Dashboard > Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugins.
  3. Select the quick-orders.zip file and proceed to install.
  4. Activate Quick Orders.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin compatible with the latest WordPress version?

Yes, Quick Orders is regularly tested and updated to ensure compatibility with the latest WordPress versions, currently tested up to version 6.8.

Do I need WooCommerce for this plugin to work?

No, Quick Orders is completely independent of WooCommerce. It’s designed as a lightweight alternative specifically for F-Commerce businesses.

Can I customize the order forms?

Yes, you can fully customize order forms using Elementor’s drag-and-drop interface. Create unique layouts, add custom fields, and style forms to match your brand.

Is Quick Orders mobile-friendly?

Absolutely! The plugin is built with a mobile-first approach, ensuring perfect functionality on smartphones, tablets, and desktop devices.

How does the parcel tracking feature work?

The parcel tracking system allows customers to track their orders using a unique tracking ID. Admins can update order status and location information in real-time.

Can I use this for my Facebook-based business?

Yes! Quick Orders is specifically designed for F-Commerce businesses, making it perfect for managing orders from Facebook and other social media platforms.

Does the plugin support multiple payment methods?

Currently, we support basic payment tracking. bKash payment gateway integration is coming soon in our next update.

Can I manage multiple products and categories?

Yes, you can manage unlimited products and organize them into categories through our intuitive admin dashboard.

Is technical knowledge required to use this plugin?

No, Quick Orders is designed to be user-friendly. Basic WordPress knowledge is sufficient to get started.

How secure is the plugin?

The plugin follows WordPress security best practices and includes features like input validation, data sanitization, and secure order processing.

Can I export order data?

Yes, you can export order data in various formats for your records or analysis.

Does it support bulk order processing?

Bulk order processing features are planned for upcoming releases to help manage multiple orders efficiently.

Is the plugin GDPR compliant?

Yes, Quick Orders follows GDPR guidelines for handling customer data and provides necessary tools for data management.

Can I use custom domains for tracking pages?

Yes, you can set up custom domains for your tracking pages to maintain brand consistency.

How often is the plugin updated?

We regularly update the plugin with new features, security patches, and compatibility improvements.
